items.name: SourceRS
items.description: A parser for Valve Map Format (VMF) files for Rust

items.name: broodmap
items.description: A pure Rust library for parsing and extracting StarCraft 1 map files (scm/scx).

items.name: nosj-ruby
items.description: gem nosj is a very fast, json-gem-compatible JSON parser and generator for Ruby: Rust and SIMD via the first-party nosj crate, partial parsing via JSON Pointer, lazy documents that parse only what you touch, memory-mapped file APIs, allocation-free validation, and a one-line gem json drop-in.

items.name: code-parser
items.description: A fast Rust CLI that statically analyses source files and returns a structured JSON map of every class, interface, mixin, enum, and method — together with its exact line range — without executing the code.

items.name: mapsforge-rs
items.description: A Rust parser for Mapsforge binary map files

items.name: gef-file-to-map
items.description: Utility library for parsing of *.gef files, used primarily in pygef

items.name: env_parser
items.description: Parses an env file which can be used to map properties in Rust code

items.name: mapsforge-rs
items.description: A Rust parser for Mapsforge binary map files, to be used in ESP32 with C Firmware

items.name: source-lang
items.description: Source file and buffer management with multi-file source maps.

items.name: opencite
items.description: Free, open-source, self-hosted legal citation verifier, Bluebook parser & case law citation graph in pure Rust — served from one memory-mapped .pack file

items.name: Meridian
items.description: Desktop app that maps how a TypeScript project's files import each other. Rust and tree-sitter do the parsing, React Flow draws the graph. Runs entirely on your machine.

items.name: Velo-Lite
items.description: Velo-Lite is a high-speed, zero-config storage engine for PHP. Built in Rust, it uses Memory-Mapped Files (mmap) and FFI to bypass the overhead of MySQL and SQL parsing. Engineered for the NVMe era, it offers near-instant I/O for local AI workflows and real-time apps. No daemons, no hassle—just a lightweight, binary-stable core for modern devs.
